description: Delete memories by ID or by filter criteria (scope, department, before_date, expired_only). Provide at least one of id or filter.

before_date.description: Delete memories created before this full ISO-8601 timestamp (UTC, e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z)

department.description: Department (e.g., legal, engineering, hr, sales, finance)

document_type.description: Type of document (e.g., contract, policy, code, incident, decision)

expired_only.description: If true, only delete expired memories

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

id.description: Delete a specific memory by ID

name: memory_delete
